introduction.name: Shailendra Singh Cahauhan
introduction.title: Full-Stack Developer | React, Next.js, Node.js | AI & Agentic Systems
introduction.summary: Full-stack software engineer with 4+ years of experience building scalable web, mobile, and desktop applications. Proficient in React.js, Next.js, React Native, Node.js, and FastAPI, with deep expertise in Generative and Agentic AI — integrating LLMs (OpenAI, Claude, Vertex AI), orchestrating agentic workflows with LangChain and LangGraph, and building RAG and OCR/PDF data-extraction pipelines. Experienced with enterprise integrations (SharePoint, SAP), cloud deployment (AWS, GCP, Azure), and database optimization (MongoDB, PostgreSQL).

projects.title: Financial Automation Platform
projects.description: AI-driven finance automation platform for AR reconciliation, transaction matching, and Human-in-the-Loop validation (CBRE).

architecture: Next.js full-stack frontend with Tailwind CSS for real-time AR visualization.
FastAPI backend with Python services for transaction matching and exception handling.
SharePoint-based bank statement ingestion pipeline feeding LLM workflows.
Vertex AI-powered LLM workflows with Human-in-the-Loop validation gates.
Cloud-deployed infrastructure for scalability, reliability, and high availability.
features: Real-time AR aging analysis and transaction monitoring.
Automated remittance matching with intelligent exception handling.
Advanced filtering and financial visibility dashboards.
Human-in-the-Loop review for ambiguous transactions.
challenges: Accurately matching remittances against open invoices at scale.
Designing HITL flows that keep humans in control of exceptions.
accomplishments: End-to-end delivery of a production finance automation platform.

projects.title: Sales Intelligence Platform
projects.description: AI-powered sales platform that analyzes customer data, generates personalized communication, and improves client engagement with data-driven insights (VEOLIA).

architecture: React.js frontend with Material UI for interactive dashboards and client detail views.
FastAPI backend services for data processing and AI-powered features.
Pandas and NumPy pipelines to transform large-scale Excel datasets.
Integrated AI features for contextual email generation and client-specific chatbots.
features: Trend analysis and product-level drill-downs.
Contextual email generation and speech assistance.
Client-specific chatbot interactions for real-time sales queries.
Advanced filtering, search, and visualization of customer data.
challenges: Processing and transforming very large Excel datasets efficiently.
accomplishments: Shipped a production AI sales platform improving client engagement.

projects.title: Multi-LLM Comparison Platform
projects.description: Unified platform to evaluate and compare outputs from multiple AI models across LLM chat, Docs-RAG, Image-RAG, image generation, and video generation (Allucent).

architecture: React.js frontend with Material UI for a unified comparison interface.
FastAPI backend services for AI evaluation and generation workflows.
Integrated APIs including DALL·E and Perplexity for real-time content generation.
Deployed on AWS for scalability, reliability, and high performance.
features: Vanilla LLM interactions across multiple models.
Docs-RAG and Image-RAG retrieval flows.
Image generation and video generation workflows.
Side-by-side evaluation and comparison of model outputs.
challenges: Normalizing heterogeneous AI outputs into a common comparison format.
Supporting multiple heavy generation workloads reliably.
accomplishments: Built a scalable multi-LLM evaluation platform on AWS.

projects.title: Biomedical Research Platform
projects.description: AI-powered platform for multi-paper summarization, protocol insights, and topic modelling to support advanced scientific analysis (Genentech).

architecture: React.js frontend with Tailwind CSS and Redux Toolkit for research data visualization.
FastAPI backend for protocol summaries, topic modelling, and AI research workflows.
Seamless frontend-backend integration for research data interaction.
AWS-deployed components for scalable, reliable operations.
features: Multi-paper summarization for scientific literature.
Protocol insights and topic modelling.
Responsive research data visualization and interaction.
challenges: Synthesizing insights across many research papers accurately.
Keeping research workflows scalable and reliable.
accomplishments: Delivered a scalable AI biomedical research platform on AWS.

projects.title: Data Insight – Conversational Data Platform
projects.description: AI chatbot that interprets natural-language queries, generates SQL, and returns data as tables, charts, and visual insights for non-technical users (Deluxe).

architecture: LLM layer interprets queries and generates SQL commands.
Secured backend APIs enable dynamic, authenticated database access.
Structured results rendered as tables, charts, and visual insights.
features: Conversational natural-language data exploration.
Real-time visualization and SQL query previews.
Secure, dynamic database access for authorized users.
challenges: Reliably translating natural language into correct SQL.
Presenting raw data transparently to non-technical users.
accomplishments: Enabled non-technical users to query complex data with ease.

projects.title: Agent Pulse – CX Monitoring Platform
projects.description: Monitoring and evaluation platform giving supervisors actionable insights into agent performance, activities, and outcomes (Startek).

architecture: Frontend dashboard for supervisors to review agent activities and outcomes.
Backend tracking, analysis, and reporting on agent performance.
Comprehensive reporting builds accountability and quality insights.
features: Tracks agent activities, interactions, and outcomes.
Comprehensive reporting and actionable insights.
Feedback and performance improvement workflows.

projects.title: Manufacturing Resource Planning
projects.description: Material Requirements Planning (MRP) web application managing demand forecasting, inventory, production scheduling, and procurement (Rock).

Financial workflows tied to demand forecasting and procurement.
Comprehensive view across the supply chain.

Production scheduling and procurement streamlining.
Comprehensive supply chain and inventory management.

projects.title: Contract Life Cycle Management

Backend with contract templates, workflow automation, and version control.

Version control and contract analytics.

projects.title: Datafusion – Home Automation Platform
projects.description: Centralized platform for monitoring and controlling smart devices within the home, keeping pace with the growing home automation trend (NITU Singapore).

architecture: Centralized web platform for device discovery and control.
Integration layer to connect heterogeneous smart devices.
Monitoring layer to observe device status and state.
features: Centralized monitoring of smart home devices.
Remote control of devices within the home.
Unified view across connected devices.
challenges: Standardizing control across heterogeneous IoT device protocols.
Building a single cohesive set of controls for a growing device set.
accomplishments: Delivered a centralized home automation control platform.
